turns.interviewer_utterance: Who are the different types of users who will use the next-generation Pontis Bridge Management System, and what are the main tasks or capabilities each role needs to perform?
turns.interviewee_utterance: We expect a few different user groups. Field inspectors need to find bridge records, review existing data, enter or update inspection findings, and attach notes or photos as needed. Planning and asset management staff need to review bridge and project information, analyze condition and needs, and support prioritization of improvements. Program or project staff need to track improvement projects tied to bridges, while supervisors and administrators need broader oversight, user control, and management of operational settings and sensitive information.
